scope: Prepared, silent installed, and explicit applied FanAndLighting runtime stages within sole cooling/RGB actors. Durable coordinator/receipt/reapply and user-facing transport not connected yet.

lines: 214-231 replace only fan/pump/lighting fields, then requests/save/rollback
269-275 fan PWM, fan RGB, pump PWM, pump RGB requests

contract.prepare: Validate full typed group, known matching sensor units, prospective RGB bases, inactive modes and Dynamic registry against retained global thermal. Missing sensors allowed with existing fallback/degraded behavior. No active mutation/HID/settings. Failed new preparation invalidates old candidate.
contract.ownership: Prepare/install/apply require current held ticket. Candidate bound to same token; stale/foreign/released tickets cannot install/apply. An installed transaction cannot restage different content under the same ticket.
contract.install: Silent desired-state installation: no HID/settings deltas. Reset applied claims and cooling anchors for new policies; retain global thermal configuration, warning history and existing grace. Coordinator must durable-commit and install both actors before invoking apply. Actor APIs do not themselves prove a receipt.
contract.apply: Reuse existing PWM/RPM/manual motherboard, thermal/base/dynamic RGB packet paths. Remain frozen until coordinator release. State exposes per-channel/zone write failures while desired intent remains installed; explicit retry needs no new settings deltas/install/revision.
contract.legacy_manual_zero: Zero manual PWM retains existing attach-replay unset semantics and is skipped. Distinguishing legacy unset from explicit manual0 remains an open parity/checklist item; Fixed0 policy is a different path.

regression.coverage: Real cooling/lighting actors with private synthetic cache, fake HID ACK/error and settings queue. No output/state mutation in prepare; no HID on install; actual apply state manual motherboard73, curve40->80, Dynamic40->80, inactive breathing RGB profile. Wrong units, failed retry invalidation and stale/foreign owner cannot install/output. HID errors retain requested intent and retry without deltas. Retained global CPU alert survives missing data after replacement; cooling falls back100 and Dynamic remains suppressed.

checks.hardware: NOT RUN: user deferred; private queues/caches only

remaining: Connect both actors through a durable coordinator/receipt commit/reapply with no late deltas
Ambiguous storage outcome and partial install/apply recovery; shutdown/sleep/detach/contended/cancel matrix
Legacy unset versus explicit manual PWM0 persistence/restart/group import
Group transfer IPC/CLI/GUI and Windows archive mapping
Physical acceptance deferred; additional LCD effects/Style Express last
